title: Nav Durga: 9 Roop, 9 Shaktiyan! 🌟
tagline: Navdurga nine forms Shailputri to Siddhidatri powers
verified_fact: The Navdurga are nine manifestations of Goddess Durga worshipped during Navratri: Shailputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayani, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, Siddhidatri — each representing a different divine power and cosmic function.
voiceover_script: Navratri ke 9 din — 9 alag roop! Pehli raat Shailputri — Parvati ka pahad wali roop. Doosri raat Brahmacharini — tapasya ki moorti. Teesri raat Chandraghanta — chaand gale mein. Phir Kushmanda — suraj ke andar se srishti. Skandamata — Kartikeya ki maa. Katyayani — sabse ugra. Kalaratri — kaali raat ka roop. Mahagauri — ati sundar shweta. Nawnwin Siddhidatri — sabki siddhi dene wali!
debate_question: Navratri mein aap kaunsa roop sabse zyada poojte ho?
pinned_comment: 🌟 Nav Durga ke 9 roop — Jai Mata Di! Navratri Mubarak!

Nav Durga: 9 Roop, 9 Shaktiyan! 🌟

🔱 Navdurga nine forms Shailputri to Siddhidatri powers

The Navdurga are nine manifestations of Goddess Durga worshipped during Navratri: Shailputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayani, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, Siddhidatri — each representing a different divine power and cosmic function.
